title: Heat illness

source.name: NIOSH — Heat-Related Illnesses — U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

steps: Move the person to a cooler, shaded area.
If the person is confused, collapsed, or has hot skin, call for help now. Treat as heat stroke.
For suspected heat stroke, cool the body quickly: cold water, ice packs, or wet cloths, and fan them.
Place ice or cold packs at the neck, armpits and groin.
If the person is alert and not vomiting, give sips of cool water.
Stay with the person and keep cooling until help takes over.
callForHelp: Hot, dry skin or profuse sweating with collapse
